verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform that holds customer data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention settings and no tenant-level data deletion or purge capability. A single 'Delete a contract by ID' endpoint is an ordinary per-resource API operation, and the GDPR 'privacy workflows' help customers run their own compliance programs; both are adjacent features, not control over how Vanta retains or deletes data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
